'''White-chocolate bread pudding''' was a dessert that presumably contained [[Chocolate/Legends|chocolate]].

[[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]], a chef at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], sometimes prepared this dessert.<ref name="Taster's Choice">{{StoryCite|story=Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>
